verdict.rationale: Linear's site says it automatically turns conversations and feedback into issues that are 'instantly routed, labeled, and prioritized for the right team' [linear-docs-62]. The changelog adds that Linear Agent can investigate newly reported issues before they reach an engineer [linear-docs-45], that Loops run agent jobs in response to events [linear-docs-36], and that users can 'triage, plan, review, and ship' in Linear [linear-docs-43]. The core of the story is directly claimed, but the evidence is marketing-level. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how AI triage and priority-setting are configured and how accurate they are, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of automatic triage on incoming bugs.
